instruction.name: adc.h
instruction.description: x86-style add with carry on 16-bit values.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: rj -> rd chain: rj and rd are the same register.

latencies.notes: All three source paths are 2 cycles: rj, rk and the carry input. The carry path is measured with `adc.h $r12, $r13, $r14; x86mtflag $r12, 1`, which reads 4.00 cycles, less the 2-cycle flag move. The instruction reads CF without writing it: two copies with distinct registers take 2.00 cycles, so they run at 1 CPI and do not serialise on the flag register, which is also the measured throughput with eight copies.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.notes: rk -> rd chain: two copies alternate rd/rk, latency is half the measured cycle count.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.init: addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 1
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --init 'addi.d $r4, $r0, 1; addi.d $r5, $r0, 2; addi.d $r6, $r0, 3; addi.d $r7, $r0, 4; addi.d $r8, $r0, 5; addi.d $r9, $r0, 6; addi.d $r10, $r0, 7; addi.d $r11, $r0, 8; x86mtflag $r0, 1' --asm 'adc.h $r12, $r4, $r5; adc.h $r13, $r5, $r6; adc.h $r14, $r6, $r7; adc.h $r15, $r7, $r8; adc.h $r16, $r8, $r9; adc.h $r17, $r9, $r10; adc.h $r18, $r10, $r11; adc.h $r19, $r11, $r12'
throughput.notes: 8 independent lanes take 8.00 cycles, i.e. 1 CPI: the instruction sustains one per cycle. Repeated runs report 8.15-8.86 cycles (1.02-1.11 CPI), which is the residual measurement floor for this short body rather than a real sub-1 IPC. Re-measured on 2026-11-17 on LA664, core 0, with --method slope (--unroll 250 --unroll2 1000).

notes: LBT instruction. Every source-to-result path is recorded separately: rj, rk, rj+rk, and CF.
